title: Can You Really Hear Your Own Heart in a Quiet Room?

scenes.text: Lie still in a silent room—do you hear your heart?
Many think you only hear it when you’re stressed or ill.
scenes.label: Only stress reveals beat

scenes.text: In a low-noise environment, the sound of blood flowing through the aorta can be heard with a stethoscope or even unaided, especially when lying down.
scenes.label: Quiet reveals blood flow

scenes.text: Your body is a built‑in speaker!
scenes.label: Body speaker
